limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 preprint leaves the matrix-space equivalence relation unspecified, so the correction distinguishes ordinary fixed-arrow module isomorphism from equivalence after an arrow-basis change rather than asserting that every possible intended reading is false. The full text of Westwick (1987) was not inspected. A concurrent author revision or independent correction is possible. No independent validation is asserted.
